pages.text: The Breeding Chamber produces baby animals in bulk without the normal breeding cooldown.$(br)$(br)Supply two captured adult animals, their matching food, water, and energy. The two parent animals are required by the recipe but are not consumed.$(br)$(br)Babies inherit traits using Minecraft's breeding rules for both parents. Sheep colors mix when a matching dye recipe exists; otherwise the baby gets one parent's color. Names and inventories belong to the parents and are not copied.$(br)$(br)Vanilla mating rules apply: tame the parents when required, and keep horse-family parents healthy. Horse and donkey parents produce a mule with inherited stats. Frogs produce frogspawn; turtles and sniffers produce eggs. Sterile and non-breedable animals have no breeding recipe.

pages.title: Construction
pages.text: 7 × 5 × 4 paired incubation bays with a center partition and two roof light banks. West inputs remain ordered parent A, parent B, food; east collects offspring. The compact clinical enclosure is distinct from the open habitat.$(br)$(br)19 frame, 21 framed glass, 8 grow light, 36 panel, 6 vent, 9 grass block. Plus the controller and 6 hatches shown in the preview.$(br)$(br)Only the current guide layout forms. Retired 2.5 layouts and the 2.6 Habitat require rebuilding. Finish active cycles and empty hatches before updating; do not break a loaded controller or hatch. Smart Hammer fills cleared spaces from inventory but cannot replace solid blocks.
